lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I rebuilt my deck. Alone. Do not look so surprised.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I took out the flashy combo everyone told me I needed. I want to see whether my idea can stand on its own.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: You can test it with me, but promise you will not solve my turns for me.

choices.label: Deal. I will play seriously and let you decide.
choices.reply: That is exactly what I wanted to hear.

choices.label: I cannot test it now, but it is your deck.
choices.reply: Yes! I want the decision to be mine, even if I lose.
